cardLine: The loaf you were handed at dusk may not be the loaf on your plate at dawn. Argue for who you think you are.

poisoner.name: Poisoner
poisoner.nightAct: Wake together and see each other. A lone Poisoner may peek one of the dead's loaves.
poisoner.cardText: You and your partner finished Lord Vane; the other plates must never learn it. Survive the dawn vote and the manor is yours.

hireling.name: Hireling
hireling.nightAct: Reads the Baker's ledger: it names the Poisoners. They do not know the Hireling.
hireling.cardText: You carried the poison and know who used it. They do not know you; take the blame if it saves them.

sinEater.name: Sin-Eater
sinEater.nightAct: Tastes one mourner's loaf, or two of the dead's.
sinEater.cardText: By custom you taste the bread of the guilty. Tonight you may taste one mourner's loaf, or two of the dead's.

cutpurse.name: Cutpurse
cutpurse.nightAct: Takes another mourner's loaf, leaves their own, reads the one taken.
cutpurse.cardText: Old habits: you take someone's loaf and leave your own. You learn what you stole, not what you left.

busybody.name: Busybody
busybody.nightAct: Swaps two other mourners' loaves without looking.
busybody.cardText: You cannot leave other people's plates alone. Swap two mourners' loaves and tell no one, not even yourself.

sot.name: Sot
sot.nightAct: Must swap their own loaf with one of the dead's, unseen.
sot.cardText: You drank the wake dry and knocked your loaf onto the oven ledge. Take one of the dead's instead; you will not remember which.

lamplighter.name: Lamplighter
lamplighter.nightAct: Last to wake; cracks their own loaf and reads it.
lamplighter.cardText: You rise before dawn to light the square. Crack your own loaf and know what you truly hold.

pallbearer.name: Pallbearer
pallbearer.nightAct: Wake together and see each other. Neither is a Poisoner.
pallbearer.cardText: You and your fellow carried the coffin and can vouch for each other. Neither of you is a Poisoner.

debtor.name: Debtor
debtor.nightAct: No night act. Wins only if turned out.
debtor.cardText: Vane held your note; if the village turns you out it dies with you. Be suspicious enough to hang, not so loud they ignore you.

gamekeeper.name: Gamekeeper
gamekeeper.nightAct: No night act. If turned out, the player they voted for is turned out too.
gamekeeper.cardText: If the village turns you out, you take your vote with you. Point carefully.

mourner.name: Mourner
mourner.cardText: You came for the bread and the will. Listen, count the claims, and vote.
